तीव r. 1st. cl. (तीवति) To be large, to be fat or corpulent.
 E. भ्वा० प०
अक० सेट् ।

तीवर m. (-रः) The ocean.
 2. A hunter, one who lives by killing and
selling game.
 3. A fisherman, one who lives by fishing.
 f. (-री) The
wife of a hunter.
 E. तॄ to go, to pass or cross, ष्वरच् aff.

तीव्र mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं)
 1. Much, excessive, endless, unbounded, unlimit-
ed.
 2.

. Hot, warm.
 m. (-व्रः) A name of ŚIVA.
 f. (-व्रा)
1. A medicinal plant,

. Black mustard.
 3. A sort of
Durva or bent grass, (गण्डदूर्व्वा)
 4. The name of a river in the east
of Bengal; also the Chandi or Padmabati. adv.
 n. (-व्रं)
 1. Much,
excessively, endless.
 2. Violently, fiercely. subst.
 1. A shore, a
bank.
 2.

. Pungency.
 E. तीव् to be large, &c. रक् aff.

तीव्रवेदना f. (-ना) Agony, excessive pain, the pain of damnation.
 E. तीव्र
exceeding, and वेदना pain.
